mapper.select: SELECT mn.*,proj.P_Name AS projectName, user.U_Name AS projectLeaderName, user1.U_Name AS responsiblePersonName, user2.U_Name AS specificContactName FROM group_project_issue mn LEFT JOIN pre_project proj ON proj.P_ID = mn.project_id LEFT JOIN sys_user user ON user.U_ID = mn.project_leader LEFT JOIN sys_user user1 ON user1.U_ID = mn.responsible_person LEFT JOIN sys_user user2 ON user2.U_ID = mn.specific_contact WHERE mn.id = #{id}
